newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 11.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Wednesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Tokyo prosecutors arrest four more executives of Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd (DKB) in payoff scandal.
-- Foreign Minister Yukihiko Ikeda hints at need to have "wartime" version of Acquisition and Cross-Servicing Agreement between Japan and the United States.
-- Improved international competitiveness leading shipbuilding firms to boost production.
-- Former Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd executive Kenji Tanaka, who was arrested on Tuesday, likely to resign as Jusco president.
-- DKB president-designate Katsuyuki Sugita does not deny bank management's responsibility for payoff case, and pledges all-out effort to recover credibility.
-- Finance Ministry to drastically review inspection system for financial institutions.
